propositions: Define immutable operation outcome value types with enums for Disposition, FailureScope, ReplaySafety, and DelaySource that serialize as lowercase strings
Implement a single retry budget owner permitting at most three physical invocations and 15,000 ms cumulative sleep with fake-clock control
Enforce canonical byte-identical JSON serialization via the existing store seam and truncate diagnostic messages to 512 Unicode code points with overflow sentinel
Retain one logical_id UUID across all invocations and implement observe-before-replay on ambiguous commits, returning recovered or forbidden commit_unknown
Permit authoritative provider delays as sleep lower bounds only if they fit remaining budget; return retry_not_before without work if over-budget
Admit only six diagnostic keys (stage, category, status_code, provider_code, retry_after_ms, message) and cap diagnostic array at eight entries with truncation sentinel
